open_questions: Roles of ScrVarEntry link2/link12/link14 (hash slot vs child ring vs free list) are inferred only from link manipulation, not named by strings; the 0x40/0x20/0x60 status bits likewise.
fn_080798e0(str,0,14|7), fn_08078ec8 and the g_08287400 string table: confirm they are the string-interning (SL_*) layer and the meaning of the 0x4 header flag walked in 0x807a0a8.
Whether 0x807c2cc reading an unset local (value word when absent, non-entity) is an original bug (observed in the binary) and what fn_08085496/fn_08085512 (class field get/set) do per class.
